# Docmost v0.97.0 contract fixtures

Responses recorded from a local, disposable Docmost 0.97.0 by
`dev/docmost/record_fixtures.py`, in the same layout as `../v0_96_0/recorded`.
`tests/contract/test_recorded.py` runs every contract test against them too. The
synthesized fixtures used by the unit tests live only in `../v0_96_0`; the contract tests
check that they only use fields 0.97.0 also returns. Never record from a production
instance.
